# dsh-subagent-models

Set the **provider, model and reasoning effort** that DeepSeek Harness subagents run with — from
**o

ne entry**, the chip beside the composer. The card it opens has two scopes over the same two
DSH-sty
le pickers: a searchable, provider-grouped model menu and that model's own effort menu.

- Web half: the composer chip + a

frame-wide card (`client.js`)
- No build step and no settings page. The Web half uses the host's

ith hand-drawn `.dsm-*` fallbacks on hosts that do not ship it.

## Where to set it / 在哪里设置
| Where | What |

| Composer → 「子代理 …」 chip | **The only entry.** Opens the card |
| Card → 「本对话」 scope | This convers

ation's override; the model menu's first row is 「跟随全局」 |
| Card → 「全局默认」 scope | The profile-wide de
fault for every conversation without an override |

The chip's label is the **effective** route for the conversation (e.g. `子代理 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ·
hi

gh`), so the composer always says what a delegation will actually use. The card's footer repeats
it
with its source: `下一次委派将使用 …（来源：本对话 / 全局默认）`.

The card's two rows are DSH-style cells — click one to open a menu anchored above it. The model
menu

matches the built-in composer model picker: a search box for catalogs above four models,
provider g

roups with sticky headings, rounded hover rows and an inline check mark on the current
choice. The e
ffort menu lists 「模型默认」 plus only the levels that model advertises.

Both menus are driven by the live LLM catalog (`ctx.llm`): models are grouped by provider, and the
e

ffort list is the one **that model** advertises (`resolveModelInfo().reasoning.efforts`), so an
unsu
pported level is never offered.

> No settings page is registered by this plugin. The built-in 设置 → 插件 → 子智能体 page belongs to
> dsh i
tself (recursion depth, concurrency, model whitelist) and is unrelated; see below.
## Precedence / 优先级

## When it takes effect / 什么时候生效

- Applies to the **next delegation** — no restart, no new conversation.
- A child that is already ru

nning keeps the route it was created with: the selection is written
once, at creation, so a changed

route affects the next delegation, not a running child.
- With no route configured, children keep in

heriting the parent session's route — exactly the
behaviour of not installing the plugin.
## How the route is applied / 怎么生效

The delegation tool (`subagent`) is composed in the **agent-plane preset**, not in the Profile
patch

, and it carries its own static `agentOptions`. A plugin cannot rewrite that composition, so
the rou
te is applied to the delegated child itself:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

DSH ≥ 0.2.2 fixes a step's model selection **before** the `agent/request` waterfall runs and now
rej

ects any proposal that changes provider, model or reasoning effort (the error it throws says
“… afte

r step preparation fixed …; use `agent.model.select()` before step preparation”), so that
seam is no

longer usable for routing. `agent.model.select()` appends a `model/selection` event —
the projectio

n a step reads its selection from — and `agent/created` is emitted (and awaited,
it is a serial even

t) after the child is constructed but before its first step prepares. The
listener is registered onc

e and only touches a Session whose `origin` is `subagent`; a top-level
Session is never touched, and

the conversation root for the per-conversation scope is found by
walking `parentSession` up until a
non-subagent Session is reached. Consequences:

- works with the official `subagent` tool, without editing the preset and without adding
model-selec

tion parameters to the tool schema;
- `subagent`, `subagent_fork` and Agent Teams members all count

rovider/model is no longer advertised by a mounted provider is skipped with a
`[subagent-models]` wa

rning — a stale route degrades to "no routing" instead of breaking the
child.
## Data / 数据
`$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/subagent-models.json` (falls back to `~/.dsh/plugin-data/`), hot-reloaded on
mtime, so editing it by hand also works:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`global.default: null` means no profile default; an absent `sessions[sessionId]` means the
conversat

: null` means no profile default; an absent `sessions[sessionId]` means the
conversation follows it.
Capability disclosure: reads and writes this one JSON file; binds no network port beyond the loopbac

k
HTTP prefix `/plugin/subagent-models` used by the Web UI; never reads conversation content,
creden
tials, or any other file.
## Limits / 限制

- `subagent_fork` children are overridden too. A fork shares the parent's prefix, so a different
mod

el costs its KV cache; clear the route (or keep the preset's own `agentOptions`) if that
matters to

you.
- An effort the chosen model does not support is rejected by the adapter's validation on the
ch

ild's first request — the plugin never silently downgrades an effort it was told to use.
- The route

is chosen once per child, at creation, and wins over the composition's `agentOptions`
because the r

ecorded selection is read before that fallback; context-window and metering
metadata follow the sele

cted route for the child's whole lifetime. Changing the route does not
re-route a child that is alre

or the child's whole lifetime. Changing the route does not
re-route a child that is already running.
